record.one_liner: Web data platform offering scrapers, proxies, SERP and browser APIs, and datasets for extracting public web data.
record.auth_notes: API key sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. The hosted and local MCP also use that API token. critic: removed oauth2; the only OAuth mention is a marketing line about agent browser login, and no OAuth flow for third-party apps is documented for the public API.
record.access_notes: Free tier with 5,000 requests/month, no credit card required, issues working API token; pay-as-you-go beyond. critic: confirmed self_serve_free.
record.api_notes: Product page cites 1,400+ scrapers plus Scraper Studio for custom collectors; REST endpoints use Bearer auth.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed, no approval or paid gate for getting a token.

evidence.quote: An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API.
Free tier: 5,000 requests per month. No credit card required. Renews monthly.
Two deployment options: a hosted remote server (one URL, no installation) or a local instance via npx @brightdata/mcp.
Connect any agent through the hosted MCP server
